The foundational toolkit for any Spigot/Paper server. Adds hundreds of commands: homes, warps, teleport requests, kits, an economy, and moderation tools. If you install one plugin, start here.

The gold-standard permissions manager. Create ranks, assign per-group permissions, and manage staff access through an in-game menu or a slick web editor. Nearly every other plugin integrates with it.

### Vault
A bridge plugin that lets economy, permissions, and chat plugins talk to each other. It does nothing on its own but is a required dependency for shops, economies, and dozens of add-ons.

### PlaceholderAPI
Lets other plugins display dynamic info (player balance, rank, ping, stats) inside scoreboards, chat, tab lists, and holograms. A silent dependency behind most polished server UIs.

## Protection & Anti-Grief

### WorldGuard
Region protection at its finest. Claim and flag areas to block PvP, mob spawning, block breaking, or explosions. Essential for spawn zones and shops.

### GriefPrevention
Gives players self-service land claims with a golden shovel, no admin intervention needed. Perfect for survival servers where you want players to protect their own builds.

A block-logging and rollback lifesaver. Every placement, break, and container access is recorded, so you can undo a griefer's damage in seconds and inspect who did what.
